runner_contract.setup: Load/reset the paired seed, then process the existing NEW case. Do not create another case for the same failed event.
runner_contract.separation: Only runner/evaluator can read this file. Retrieval reads database raw sources only, never expected or simulation.future events.
runner_contract.question_release: If NOT_ASKED, assert immediate completion without a question or runtime response. Otherwise bind one scripted outcome to the actual permitted question.
runner_contract.scripted_reply_scope: Expected final labels apply to the supplied scripted buyer_reply. Arbitrary live text in a demo may produce different valid outputs; do not force it to match a different scripted reply.
runner_contract.no_reply: Manual USER_NO_REPLY retains assessment 1, leaves phase two null and finalizes policy as ESCALATE_REVIEW without inference.

evaluation_rules.missing_info: Compare as an unordered set of approved codes, with [] distinct from an absent/null assessment.
evaluation_rules.evidence: Validate source availability, factual support and verification; compare semantic facts rather than exact wording, ordering or exact array length. Every source_ref must resolve.
evaluation_rules.reason: Check policy meaning and required conditions; not mandatory verbatim text equality.
evaluation_rules.question: Compare one focused actual question where permitted, zero for NOT_ASKED; reference wording is illustrative.
behavior: No second question or third Agent round on no-reply
No forced confidence increase from intent alone
evaluation_rules.not_measured: No claim of model accuracy on real shipments, actual cost savings or delivery success. These are synthetic scenario-behavior labels.
